t: Im muttar lelek al gabbe haasabim veken bailan
s: Im muttar lelek al gabbe haasabim veken bailan ubo k"b seipim: en olin bailan ben lach ben yabesh, veen nitlin bo (veen nishanim alayv), veen mishtammeshin bo shum tashmish, kegon lehanniach alayv chepetz o littelo mimmennu, o liqshor bo behema, veken kol kayyotze baellu, vehakkol mishshum gezera shemma yaaleh veyitlosh mimmennu perot o alin o anapim. Vegazeru bekol hailanot, ap bibeshim sheen bahem perot vealin vaanapim, mishshum seyag vegader. Abal bor amoq apillu mea amma — muttar lo lered velaalot bo, umetappes veyored, umetappes veoleh, veen chosheshin shemma yaaqor qarqa bemitkavven biridato vaaliyyato (vitaqqen madrega veyitchayyeb mishshum boneh), lepi shehaadam nizhar bezeh yoter mibbitlisha mehailan:

Lo yaaleh bailan mibbeod yom veyesheb sham kol hashshabbat kullah, shehayshiba sheyyosheb sham — tashmish hu shemmishtammesh bailan. Veim ala mibbeod yom — muttar lered mishshechasheka. Veken im ala beshabbat beshogeg — muttar lered. Veap shebbirida zo hu mishtammesh bailan — en leesor bishbil kak, hoil veap bishibato sham hu mishtammesh bailan. Abal im ala mishshechasheka bemezid — qenasuhu chakamim lihyot sham kol hashshabbat, veasur lo lered. Veyesh omerim sheapillu im ala mibbeod yom bemezid al daat sheyyishshaer yosheb sham mishshechasheka — qenasuhu chakamim. Velo hittiru lo lered mishshechasheka kesheala mibbeod yom, ella kesheala al daat lered mibbeod yom venishtaha sham beshogeg. Uleinyan halaka — bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Vekol zeh beadam sheala sham, sheyyesh issur baamidato sham, laken hittiru lered ap shemmishtammesh bailan birida zo. Abal im hinniach alayv chepetz apillu mibbeod yom — asur littelo mishshechasheka, lepi shebbintila zo hu mishtammesh bailan, ukeshehachepetz munnach sham en hu mishtammesh bailan:

Vekol zeh bailan vekayyotze bo, abal qanim harakkim keyaraq — muttar lehishtammesh bahem ap al pi shemmechubbarim baqqarqa, mippene shello gazeru ella al ilan, abal beyaraq vekayyotze bo — lo hizkiru chakamim shebut, vahare hem kaasabim shehittiru lahalok alehem kemo sheyyitbaer. Umikkol maqom tzarik lizzaher keshemmishtammesh beyaraq vekayyotze bo shello yezizem beyadayv, mippene shehem muqtzeh kedin kol mechubbar, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shy"b. Abal qanim shehuqshu qetzat veenam rakkim keyaraq, ap sheenam qashim kailan — asur lehishtammesh bahem, vehechemiru bahem chakamim yoter mibbailan leinyan sheyyitbaer besimman t"t:

Shorshe ilan haggebohim min haaretz g' tepachim kemo shehu beilanot hazzeqenim — hare hem kailan, veasur lehishtammesh bahem ap al pi sheen lachush bahem shemma yitlosh, lepi shello chillequ chakamim bezeh, kemo shennitbaer. Abal im enam gebohim g' tepachim — hare hen kaqqarqa, umuttar lehishtammesh bahem. Veken haddin beqilche kerub shehuqshu:

Veken haddin baanapim haggedelim beiqqaro shel ilan pachot mig' tepachim, o apillu gedelim lemala mig' tepachim venikpapim lematta mig' tepachim — muttar lehishtammesh bahem bemaqom sheenan gebohim g' tepachim, abal lo bemaqom sheggebohim g' tepachim. Veap al pi sherosh zeh hannikpap lematta veeno gaboah g' tepachim hu gadel uba mimmaqom haasur, dehaynu miggaboah g' tepachim, ukeshehaya sham mittechilla haya asur lehishtammesh bo, ap al pi ken kesheggadel yoter venikpap lematta — huttar mippene shennaasa kaqqarqa, shekkol pachot mig' tepachim samuk laaretz — hare hu kaaretz. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehishtammesh beiqqaro shel ilan pachot mig' tepachim samuk laaretz, ap al pi shehailan hu gaboah meod, shehare maqom zeh shehu pachot mig' tepachim lo neesar meolam:

Hayu gebohim g' tepachim vechalal tachtehem mishsheloshet tzedadehem, umitztzad echad en chalal tachtehem, shehaqqarqa gaboah sham vahare hem shavim sham laaretz — asur lehishtammesh apillu batztzad hashshaveh laaretz. Abal im mib' tzedadim hem shavin laaretz umib' tzedadim hem gebohim g' tepachim mehaaretz — muttar lehishtammesh apillu bitzdadim haggebohim ad keneged maqom shemmuttar lehishtammesh bitzdadim hashshavim:
Muttar lelek al gabbe asabim beshabbat, vaapillu holek yachep veepshar sheyyidbequ asabim beqishre etzbeotayv veyittaleshu, mikkol maqom dabar sheen mitkavven hu umuttar:

Hammashqeh mayim lizraim — chayyab mishshum choresh umishshum zorea, mippene shemmerappeh umerakkek et haqqarqa kemo hachoresh, vehu shemmitkavven lehatzmiach hazzeraim kemo hazzorea. Ulepikak, mi sheokel beginna — tzarik lizzaher shello littol yadayv al haasabim, mippene shemmashqeh otam. Veap sheeno mitkavven lekak — "pesiq resheh velo yamut hu". Veap im okel beginnat chabero, o apillu shel nokri, sheen lo chepetz kelal begiddul haasabim shebbah, vahare hu melaka sheenah tzerika legupah — mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim. Abal muttar lehattil alehem me raglayim o yayin ushear mashqim, mippene shehem sorepim otam, veen matzmichim otam ella mayim bilbad. Verauy lizzaher ap bemashqin. Vetob shello leekol kelal beginna im yishtammesh sham im mayim, mippene shebbeqoshi yukal lizzaher shello yippol sham meat mayim:

Yesh lizzaher millehashlik zeraim bimqom yeridat geshamim, shessopan lehatzmiach sham. Veim yashlik letarnegolim — lo yashlik ella keshiur sheyyoklu bo bayyom o leyomayim. Veim hu bimqom derisat ragle adam — muttar, sheen sopan litzmoach, veen bo mishshum zorea:

Asabim shealu al ozen hakkeli millachut hakkeli — chashubim kimchubbarim laqqarqa, kevan shezzehu derek giddulan, vehattoleshan — chayyab mishshum "oqer dabar miggiddulo". Veken hattolesh kishshut mimmeqom giddulo, ap al pi sheeno mechubbar laqqarqa. Abal hattolesh zeraim shennizreu beatzitz sheeno naqub — patur, mippene sheen derek zeria sham. Abal asur litlosh mimmennu middibre soperim, apillu hu munnach baaliyya:

Hattolesh meatzitz naqub — chayyab, mippene shehu kimchubbar laqqarqa, lepi sheyyoneq min haqqarqa al yede hanneqeb shemmeriach lachluchit haqqarqa derek sham. Vaapillu hu munnach al gabbe yetedot, sheyyesh avir mapsiq beno laqqarqa — hare hu kimchubbar, lepi sheyyoneq qetzat min haqqarqa derek haavir. Ulepikak, im haya munnach al gabbe qarqa vehinnicho al gabbe yetedot — eno chayyab mishshum tolesh min hattora, hoil vaadayin kimchubbar hu. Veken im haya munnach al gabbe yetedot vehinnicho al gabbe qarqa — eno chayyab mishshum notea min hattora. Abal middibre soperim asur littelo meal gabbe qarqa lehannicho al gabbe yetedot, mishshum sheddomeh letolesh. Veken im haya munnach al gabbe yetedot — asur lehannicho al gabbe qarqa, mishshum sheddomeh lenotea. Vekol zeh beatzitz naqub, abal besheeno naqub — muttar. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshel etz, abal shel cheres, apillu sheeno naqub — hu kenaqub, sheen hacheres omed bipne hashsharashim, vehem mepapeim veyoneqim min haqqarqa derek hacheres. Veyesh omerim behepek, shebbammeh debarim amurim? Beshel cheres, abal shel etz hu mitlachleach mehaqqarqa, veeno omed bipne hashsharashim ap sheeno naqub. Veyesh lachush leb' hassebarot, velizzaher ben beshel etz ben beshel cheres ap al pi sheenan nequbim:
Asabim shettechaban beapar mibbeod yom kede sheyyihyu lachim, im miqtzat alin megullin — muttar leechoz bahem ulehotziam, al derek shennitbaer besimman shy"a:
Yichur shel ilan shennipshach meereb shabbat min hailan ubo perot — muttar litlosh mimmennu happerot beshabbat:

Tzinnor hamqalleach mayim min haggag vealu bo qashshim vaasabim shessotemim umeakkebim qillucho umemayv yotzeim umitpashshetim baggag vedolepim labbayit — muttar lemaako beraglayv betzina, shekkevan shemmetaqqen al yede shinnuy hu, sheeno oseh ella beraglayv — lo gazeru bezeh bimqom hepsed:

Etrog vetappuach vekol dabar harauy laakila — asur lehariach bo beodo mechubbar, gezera shemma yaqotz oto kede leoklo. Abal hadas mechubbar — muttar lehariach bo, shehare en hanaato ella recho, vezeh yakol laasot apillu beodo mechubbar velamma yiqtzetzennu, mah sheen ken dabar harauy laakila. Veap im yoklennu beodo mechubbar — en leka telisha gedola mizzo. Veap sheen derek telisha bepiv ella beyad bilbad upatur hu min hattora (kemo shehayyoneq bepiv patur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"ch) — mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim:

Hashshoreh chittim useorim vekayyotze bahem bemayim kede sheyyitzmechu — hare zeh toledet zorea, vechayyab bekol shehu. Vehu sheshshoreh zeman arok, abal muttar litten seorim lemayim lehaakil libhemot lealtar. (Veap im yishshaer bemayim meakilatam — en bekak kelum, lepi shebbeshaa shennetanam lemayim — lav "pesiq resheh" hu sheyyatzmichu, sheepshar shehabbehema tokal et kullam):

Anpe ilanot shehukenu letashmish mibbeod yom beinyan sheyyesh torat keli alehem umuttarim betiltul kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"ch — muttar lehaamidam bemayim beshabbat. Ubilbad shello yihyu bahem perachim veshoshannim, shehem niptachim millachluchit hammayim. Vetzarik lizzaher shello litten mayim el keli kede lehaamidam sham, ella yaamidem bemayim shehayu bikli mikkebar. Vaapillu heemidam bemayim mibbeod yom — asur lehosip alehem mayim beshabbat veyom tob, mippene shettoreach letaqqen keli, ayyen simman trn"d:
Teenim sheyyabeshu beibbehem, veken shear hailanot sheyyabeshu perotehem bahem — hattolesh mehem beshabbat chayyab, ap al pi shehem kitlushim leinyan tuma:

Asur lehishtammesh bitzdade hailan, abal betzidde tzedadin — muttar. Ketzad? Sullam hassamuk litzdade hailan — asur laalot bo beshabbat, shebbaaliyyato hu mishtammesh bitzdade hailan shehu samuk bahem, abal im yesh yated taqua betzidde hailan — muttar lismok hassullam beyated velaalot alayv, shehayyated hu tzedadin, vehassullam tzidde tzedadin. Veken im naatz yated bailan vetala bo kalkala — hayyated niqra tzedadin, vehakkalkala tzidde tzedadin, umuttar littol chepetz mehakkalkala, abal hakkalkala atzmah asur littol, mippene shebbintila zo hu mishtammesh bayyated shehu tzedadin. Veim hakkalkala teluya bailan atzmo — hi niqret tzedadayv, veasur littol mimmenna chepetz. Veim pi hakkalkala tzar shekkeshennotel hachepetz mehakkalkala menid hailan — asur bekol inyan, mippene shemmishtammesh bailan atzmo:
(Muttar lehishshaen beilan bari, abal betash asur, mippene shemmenido, vahare zeh mishtammesh bailan):
Muttar ligga bailan, veasur lahanido (mippene shehu muqtzeh, veasur betiltul):
